bluf: Juris Digital is a Denver, CO law firm marketing agency, founder led since 2015 with 10 to 50 staff, selling JurisOS, its system for turning search demand into signed cases, to small firms across five practice areas. The record shows it leaning into local and AI: Local Services Ads work evidenced (P3 making), a JD Assistant research tool and LinkedIn ads about AI Overviews. The one thing a rival should know: the Monsoon read puts it at Landfall, displacement 79.1, with 5 of 6 named clients names only and 0 sitemap updates in 365 days; it is very likely, with moderate confidence, beatable on price.
doing:
The positioning line, in the record's words: a law firm digital marketing agency selling JurisOS, its system for capturing search demand and converting it into signed cases, plus content, creative and paid media. In plain words: a legal SEO shop selling a named process. The headline claim is a 4.7 out of 5 rating from attorney clients on the homepage; the legal entity is Ethical SEO Consulting LLC and the co founders are Casey Meraz and Matt Green.

SEO leads at score 3: the JSON-LD pitches SEO strategies and the law firm SEO pages run by practice area. Four core lines sit at score 2: Content & Digital PR (practice area content by legal writers, success story creation, original research on how people hire lawyers), Local (local SEO for lawyers and Local Services Ads pages), Paid Search (Google Ads and LSAs with intake grade tracking) and Web & Product (law firm website design, a Performance Creative line, a design portfolio). Proprietary items on record: JurisOS, FirmTech, JurisLingo, JD Assistant, free legal marketing tools (SERP previews, a citation checker) and the original research. No partners are listed; Paid Social, Email & CRM and CRO score 0.

The AI posture is JD Assistant, its own AI research assistant for legal marketing, plus an llm info page, while its LinkedIn ads warn defense firms about AI Overviews; AI Search / GEO scores only 1 and the Horus read has P1 partial. Pricing: the homepage FAQ addresses agency pricing, long term contracts and competitor exclusivity, but the answers were not captured, so P5 is unknown.

The record lists no moves, news, case study entries or jobs. Conspicuously absent for a legal marketing shop selling intake grade tracking: any Data & Measurement evidence above score 1, any CRM or email line, and any updated sitemap URL in 365 days.
clients:
The client type is SMB law firms; the verticals listed are personal injury, family, employment, estate planning and criminal defense law. The home market is the US from a Denver, CO office.

The book holds 6 names, all from case study slugs, 1 with an observed need and 5 names only. Observed: Grossman Law (brand and creative, a blog design slug), which gives a mix read of brand 1.0 on one case. Names only: Silva Injury Law, TAC Injury Law, Massingill Law, Wood Edwards Estate Planning and Pines Federal, success story slugs with no described work. For these the need is inferred from what Juris Digital leads with: organic demand through law firm SEO first, local and lead generation for the injury firms the Local Services Ads line targets, and web build where the design portfolio applies; the record says nothing more. The LinkedIn ads add the buyer it wants: defense firms worried about AI Overviews and intake teams paying for parking ticket leads.

No client sits on another tracked agency's book (shared 0), and the volume claims exist without names: a 4.7 out of 5 rating and a portfolio of design case studies.

openings:

The Monsoon read puts displacement at 79.1, Landfall, on an SMB book buying SEO and web hours: it is very likely, with moderate confidence, that an offshore delivered or outcome priced rival undercuts Juris Digital line by line, since no public pricing model shows (P5 unknown). Its LinkedIn ads sell fear of AI Overviews while AI Search / GEO scores 1 and no audited visibility product shows (P1 partial), and there is no sign of ads inside AI assistants (P8 absent): a rival with a measured citation share leads with the number, likely with moderate confidence.
